title: A Border of Flowers

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Welcome back to the scriptorium! All spring we've been copying a new book of stories, for the library in Bellhaven.

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: The last page needs a border of flowers. Will you paint it, in a pattern?

steps.speaker: elias
steps.prompt: Carry on the pattern of flowers. What comes next?

older.prompt: Carry on the pattern: red, red, yellow, blue, yellow. What comes next?

feedback.all_good: A border fit for a king's book!

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: Beautiful. Brother Thomas says it's the finest border in the whole book. Now it only needs binding.

journal_line: I painted a border of flowers in the monastery's new book.
